object_context: Child obstruction of BSD-A1-RANK2-BRIDGE: for E/Q with exact complex analytic rank two, isolate the weakest source-bound hypotheses under which the complex condition forces a suitable generalised Kato class kappa_p(E) to be nonzero, without importing BSD, dim Sel=2, or a main-conjecture input that already contains equivalent-strength arithmetic rank information.
structural_coordinates: the root target remains the complex BSD rank/leading-term statement over Q, not a p-adic Selmer surrogate
exact analytic rank two means sign +1, L(E,1)=L'(E,1)=0, and L''(E,1) nonzero after the chosen normalization
classical Heegner points are torsion in analytic rank greater than one, so the rank-one first-derivative witness is route-pruned
generalised Kato classes provide a higher-order p-adic Selmer object in positive even analytic-rank settings under explicit good-ordinary and auxiliary-form hypotheses
nonvanishing of the generalised Kato class and mere construction of the class are separate obligations
Castella-Hsieh prove kappa nonzero implies p-adic Selmer dimension two under explicit hypotheses; Castella 2026 sharpens the converse to require nonzero localization
p-adic Selmer dimension two does not definitionally equal Mordell-Weil rank two because a Sha Tate-module contribution may remain
a derived p-adic height or p-adic regulator is not automatically the complex Neron-Tate regulator or the full Clay leading coefficient
auxiliary CM characters/forms and nonvanishing L(E,ad^0(g),1) are technical coordinates that cannot be erased in a generic transfer
main-conjecture input must be classified by logical strength and specialization before it can serve as an analytic-to-arithmetic bridge
equivalent_formulations: prove that exact complex order two forces nonzero kappa_p(E) for at least one admissible good ordinary prime and auxiliary datum, with all hypotheses explicit
identify a proved complex-to-p-adic leading-term formula whose nonzero complex second derivative forces the p-adic quantity controlling kappa_p(E) to be nonzero
show that every current proof of kappa_p(E) nonvanishing from rank-two-looking data introduces a Selmer/localization/main-conjecture assumption, and isolate the minimal missing comparison theorem
construct an implication graph from L''(E,1) through the relevant triple-product or anticyclotomic p-adic L-function to kappa_p(E), marking the first conjectural edge
solved_analogues: analytic rank one: Gross-Zagier supplies a first-derivative/Heegner-height bridge and Kolyvagin turns nontrivial Heegner data into strong rank/Sha control under its hypotheses

cross_domain_analogies.source_situation: A physical quantity may be nonzero at the source while a downstream sensor reads zero if an intermediate transfer function has a null direction; proving source nonzero does not prove sensor nonzero without calibrating every transfer stage.
common_abstraction: nonzero information must cross a chain of representation changes
each bridge can have a kernel
a downstream nonvanishing claim requires either injectivity or a source-specific exclusion of the kernel
source_to_target_mapping: sensor output -> generalised Kato class kappa_p(E)
sensor nullspace -> localization or reciprocity/kernel obstruction
shared_constraints: nonzero source alone is insufficient when a transfer map can kill it
a bypass assumption that directly asserts the downstream value destroys diagnostic value
disanalogies: the arithmetic bridges are theorems between different cohomological/analytic objects rather than linear laboratory transfer functions
no global linear operator is given
nonvanishing may depend on auxiliary arithmetic choices
cross_domain_analogies.proposed_principle: Factor the complex-to-kappa implication into explicit bridge maps/identities and test the earliest stage at which nonvanishing can be lost; do not treat a p-adic main conjecture as a transparent wire.
cross_domain_analogies.validation_obligation: For any proposed analytic-rank-two-to-kappa theorem, identify every intermediate analytic/p-adic/cohomological object, state the exact nonvanishing-preserving theorem at each arrow, and exhibit the cheapest kernel/localization failure that would invalidate the transfer.
cross_domain_analogies.provenance_note: Proposal-only structural analogy; it supplies no arithmetic theorem authority.

analogy_scan_notes: Scanned rank-one derivative-to-point transfer, rank-two p-adic Selmer results, and measurement-chain failure modes.
